verdict.rationale: Kimi's own help center lists "记忆" (memory) among the assistant's general features, so the product documents a memory capability of its own. The pack gives only that one-line category title, with no description of how memory works or whether it carries context across separate chats. missing for 10: documentation that memory persists across conversations, evidence that remembered context is applied in new chats, any user controls for viewing or managing memories, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
